description:
[read-only] Spend, impressions, clicks, conversions and conversion value per day across the brand's ad accounts (from / to as YYYY-MM-DD, default the last 30 days), with totals per currency. A 202 answer means Meta is still backfilling: ask again after Retry-After seconds. Read only.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/timeline.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

connection.description: One ad account (`key` from a previous answer). Default: all of the brand's.

from.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: the configured number of days before `to`.

to.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today. The range has a configured maximum.

name: ads_timeline
title: Daily ads spend and results
